title: NES fugue in D minor
prompt: A fast hook-based fugue for the NES alone, in D minor at 164 bpm. A larger form instead of one motif answered all the way through: A B A C B A, with B in F. Drums change per section: jungle in A, half-time in B, breakbeat in C. Free voices in driving 16ths, an octave-pulse bass.
